name: Online @ The Perfect Time
source:
"Online @ the perfect time" follows you, a student in their final year of university, overwhelmed with what’s to come afterwards. After stumbling across a new anime, you decide to search the web for something more, anything, to elevate your stress and continue this train of procrastination.

Nothing is thought of it at first, until you meet a group of new friends who are more welcoming than you could’ve ever imagined. 

[edited from [url=https://onlineatpt.itch.io/online-the-perfect-time]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《在线@完美时光》跟随你，一名大学最后一年的学生，对接下来的事情感到不知所措。在偶然发现一部新动漫后，你决定在网络上搜索更多内容，任何内容，以增加你的压力并继续这一系列的拖延。

一开始你什么也没想，直到你遇到了一群比你想象的更热情的新朋友。

[编辑自[url=https://onlineatpt.itch.io/online-the-perfect-time]itch.io[/url]]
